notes: τάς takes the supplied his under rules 20 and 76: αὐτοῖς is already spent on the dative object on them and so is not available to displace the determiner — rule 76's own ἐπέβαλεν ἐπ᾽ αὐτὸν τὴν χεῖρα is this very shape.
παιδία heads on children, both English words glossing an element of the diminutive (rule 66).
